tasks.short: Recommend changes in working conditions or equipment.

steps.what: Watch working conditions and the equipment the crew uses.
Decide which changes would increase efficiency.
Recommend those changes in working conditions or equipment.

tasks.design: She watches the crew's working conditions and equipment, decides which changes would increase efficiency, and recommends them to the crew. No roster is generated and nothing is sent. No alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The conditions and the equipment are something she has to see on the job.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new watches the crew or chooses the changes for her.
tasks.still_hard: A crew she did not watch stays unjudged.
tasks.human_edge: She can recommend only the conditions and equipment she watched.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still watches the crew and recommends the changes.

reach.learn: A change in equipment is one she recommended after watching the crew.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she recommends crew changes from the working conditions and equipment she watched, and a cleaning schedule or a quote calculation does not make that recommendation.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
The crew are colleagues. She watched the conditions, then tells them in person.
No version is filed and nothing is sent, so the spoken recommendation is not gated. No model recommends. No alert is raised. No listing replaces the walk.
unknowns: Whether the firm later requires the recommendation in writing.
research_questions: Who else may change the equipment after she has recommended it.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one job she watches the working conditions and equipment, decides the changes, and recommends them, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer customer inquiries on methods, materials, and prices.

steps.what: Hear inquiries from current or prospective customers regarding methods and materials.
Open the stored rate and read the price ranges.
Decide which methods, materials, and price ranges fit this site.
Answer the customers with those methods, materials, and price ranges.

tasks.design: She hears the inquiry, opens the stored rate in the {ERP} and reads the price range, decides the method and material for the site, and answers the customer herself. No reply is drafted for her. No chatbot answers. No alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The method and the material depend on the site she has just heard about.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new chooses the method or answers the customer for her.
tasks.still_hard: A site she has not heard about stays unanswered.
tasks.human_edge: She can name a method only for the inquiry she heard.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads the price range and answers the customer.

reach.learn: A price range is one the supervisor opened and read, then decided.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she hears the inquiry, opens the stored rate, and answers the customer herself. A quote calculation does not choose the method or the material for the site.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.

The estimator keeps the rate record on the estimate task, which is outside this task. The fields are the method, the material, and the price range. That capture is not counted as saved here. If a field is missing she does not invent a price.
She still opens and reads the record. That reading is the second step. It is not free and it is not saved. No listing replaces the reading. The rate record is the {ERP} category.
No model drafts a reply and no chatbot answers the customer. She files no version and sends no written reply, so the spoken answer is not a gated send. No alert is raised.
unknowns: Whether a missing rate is kept by the estimator or only in her head.
research_questions: Who else may change a price range after she has answered.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one inquiry she hears the customer, opens and reads the stored price range, decides the method and material, and answers, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Walk the site and note where sprinkler systems must reach.
Design the layout by calculating water pressure, valve placement, and coverage needs.
Supervise the installation from that sketch.

tasks.design: She walks the site, designs the sprinkler by calculating water pressure, valve placement, and coverage, and supervises the crew's installation from that sketch. No design is generated and no standing version is filed. No alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: Water pressure and coverage depend on the site she has to walk.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new calculates the pressure or supervises the installation for her.
tasks.still_hard: A site she did not walk stays undesigned.
tasks.human_edge: She can size the sprinkler only for the site she walked.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still calculates the sprinkler and supervises the installation.

reach.learn: Installation follows the pressure and coverage she calculated on the site.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she calculates water pressure and coverage on the site and supervises the installation herself, and a cleaning schedule or a quote calculation does not do that design.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
The crew are colleagues. She directs the installation in person.
The sketch is her own working note. No standing version is filed and nothing is sent, so it is not gated. No model calculates the pressure. No alert is raised. No listing replaces the walk.
unknowns: Whether a later task files the sprinkler sketch as a standing drawing.
research_questions: Who else may change valve placement after she has calculated it.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one site she notes the sprinkler systems, calculates water pressure and coverage, and supervises the installation, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Hear the customer's landscaping or lawn service request.
Decide the fees she can offer for that groundskeeping.
Negotiate with customers regarding those fees.

tasks.design: She hears the landscaping request, decides the fee, and negotiates it with the customer in person. No fee version is filed or sent. No alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The fee depends on the work the customer has just described.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new negotiates the fee for her.
tasks.still_hard: A customer she has not heard stays unpriced.
tasks.human_edge: She can settle a fee only in the conversation she is in.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still negotiates the fee with the customer.

reach.learn: A fee is settled in the conversation, not by a generated quote.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she negotiates the fee with the customer in person, and a quote calculation does not hold that conversation.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
The customer is outside the organisation. She hears the request, then negotiates in person.
No fee version is filed or sent, so the talk is not a gated send. No model negotiates. No alert is raised. No listing of fees replaces the talk.
unknowns: Whether an agreed fee must later be sent as a quote on another task.
research_questions: Who else may change a fee after she has negotiated it.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one negotiation she hears the landscaping request, decides the fee, and negotiates it, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

role.altitude: She still recommends crew changes, answers customers, designs and supervises sprinklers, and negotiates fees. Nothing is handed off.
reach: A groundskeeping worker learns a crew recommendation comes from conditions she watched, not from a generated roster.
A janitorial supervisor learns a customer price is one she opened and read, not a generated reply.
skills_to_grow: Recommend equipment changes only from conditions she watched.
Read a price range herself before she answers a customer.
Calculate sprinkler pressure on the site.
role.ambitious_version: The same supervisor still recommends, answers, designs, supervises, and negotiates. Nothing is sent in her place.
